hypotheses.title: Xanthine extends lifespan in Drosophila melanogaster
hypotheses.claim: Administration of xanthine extends lifespan in Drosophila melanogaster. The compound acts on conserved metabolic pathways to delay age-related decline in the fly.
hypotheses.rationale: Xanthine participates in purine metabolism, which influences energy balance and oxidative stress. Modulating this pathway can therefore alter the pace of ageing in Drosophila melanogaster.
hypotheses.prediction: Flies treated with xanthine will show significantly longer median and maximum lifespan than untreated controls.
hypotheses.experiment: Maintain cohorts of Drosophila melanogaster on food with and without xanthine under identical conditions and compare survival curves using log-rank analysis.

hypotheses.title: SR27897 extends lifespan in Drosophila melanogaster
hypotheses.claim: Administration of SR27897 extends lifespan in Drosophila melanogaster. The compound acts on conserved signalling pathways to delay age-related decline in the fly.
hypotheses.rationale: SR27897 modulates nutrient-sensing signalling that governs growth and metabolism. Adjusting these conserved pathways can shift resource allocation toward maintenance and extend lifespan in Drosophila melanogaster.
hypotheses.prediction: Flies treated with SR27897 will show significantly longer median and maximum lifespan than untreated controls.
hypotheses.experiment: Maintain cohorts of Drosophila melanogaster on food with and without SR27897 under identical conditions and compare survival curves using log-rank analysis.

hypotheses.title: N-acetyl-L-cysteine accelerates ageing in Drosophila melanogaster
hypotheses.claim: Administration of N-acetyl-L-cysteine accelerates ageing in Drosophila melanogaster. The compound disrupts redox homeostasis in a manner that hastens age-related decline in the fly.
hypotheses.rationale: Reactive oxygen species serve as signalling molecules that activate stress-response and maintenance programmes. Suppressing them with N-acetyl-L-cysteine can impair these defences and accelerate ageing in Drosophila melanogaster.
hypotheses.prediction: Flies treated with N-acetyl-L-cysteine will show significantly shorter median and maximum lifespan than untreated controls.
hypotheses.experiment: Maintain cohorts of Drosophila melanogaster on food with and without N-acetyl-L-cysteine under identical conditions and compare survival curves using log-rank analysis.

hypotheses.title: SR27897 extends lifespan via insulin/IGF signalling activation
hypotheses.claim: SR27897 extends lifespan in Drosophila melanogaster by activating the insulin/IGF signalling pathway. Activation of this pathway mediates the longevity effect of the compound in the fly.
hypotheses.rationale: The insulin/IGF signalling pathway regulates metabolism, growth and stress resistance in a manner that shapes lifespan. SR27897 can engage this pathway to trigger transcriptional programmes that extend lifespan in Drosophila melanogaster.
hypotheses.prediction: SR27897-treated flies will live longer than controls, and genetic or pharmacological blockade of insulin/IGF signalling will abolish this extension.
hypotheses.experiment: Compare lifespan responses to SR27897 in Drosophila melanogaster carrying reduced insulin/IGF pathway activity versus matched controls, and measure pathway target phosphorylation in treated flies.

hypotheses.title: Dofetilide extends lifespan in Drosophila melanogaster
hypotheses.claim: Administration of dofetilide extends lifespan in Drosophila melanogaster. The compound acts on conserved ion channel function to delay age-related decline in the fly.
hypotheses.rationale: Ion channel activity shapes membrane excitability and cellular stress responses that influence ageing. Modulating potassium channel function with dofetilide can therefore alter lifespan in Drosophila melanogaster.
hypotheses.prediction: Flies treated with dofetilide will show significantly longer median and maximum lifespan than untreated controls.
hypotheses.experiment: Maintain cohorts of Drosophila melanogaster on food with and without dofetilide under identical conditions and compare survival curves using log-rank analysis.
